notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v0.14.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Salutations![/b]


To get started: We're back from vacation! [strike](and other deviations...)[/strike]

First, we'd like to get the main branch of the game on the same level as Experimental, as we have some exciting content coming to Experimental in not very long! We don't want to say much of about it right now, but we can asure you it's great stuff!

This patch will bring more modding capability to the main branch as well as some quality of life changes and fixes.

[quote][h1][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/h1]

[b]New additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a delete button to workshop items.
[*] Added color markers to selected objects in the scope dropdown menu.
[*] Added highlightning to warning triangles.
[*] Added functionality for replacing lines from the vanilla content.
[*] Added the option to prioritize activities in the Department activity view.
[*] Added the patients' conditions in the activity view of a Department.
[*] Added links to a patient's journal in the Department activity view.
[*] Added more detailed error messages when loading a mod with errors.
[*] Added a Recruit Staff button to the Department staff window.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the support for mods with identical names.
[*] Improved text popups to tell if rooms are needed in  the hospital or a department.
[*] Doubleclicking on a room template text will now open the handbook.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error which caused the "one moment" screen to get stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "Remove mod" button.
[*] Fixed the "missing mod" error message.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the loading circle on the recruitment screen to continue while paused.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused unnassigned rooms to be stuck with the wrong department color.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused all rooms for a task to seemingly be required within the department even though it is not specified as such in the task.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused entries to appear twice in warning popups.
[*] Fixed several typos.
[*] Fixed a bug in storing and selling objects.
[*] Fixed a bug in the room assignment mechanics.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the room warning triangles to get stuck if the room was destroyed.
[*] Fixed an error which caused the Department activity list to freeze.
[*] Fixed a bug which disabled the option to prioritize tasks.
[*] Minor improvements++.
[/list]

For a more detailed look at the modding changes, please click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/503370/discussions/4/1693795812309449928/]here[/url]!
We're also (usually) quite quick to read the messages on Discord if you should need any modding assistance! (link below)[/quote]

"It's been a long and beautiful summer, with many challenges to overcome. Hope you have had a nice summer as well! We have made some improvements to the game which we're patching now, and we have worked on an all new feature we like to call "Translations", which we're putting up on the Experimental Branch in not too long. We're hoping for an exciting autumn filled with Hospitalize!"
 [i][b] - Illeris I Thomas[/b][/i]

"[i]Don't forget to check out our [url=https://discord.gg/rzXhdMs]Discord[/url] server ;)[/i]"
 [i][b] - Illeris I Hans[/b][/i]


[b]Thank you!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Hospitalize Info
notes.content:
[h1][b]The State of Hospitalize![/b][/h1]

[b]Greetings Everyone![/b]


We would like to go over a little bit about what state both us and Hospitalize is in right now, so that you guys know exactly what page we are on at this point in time!

To start off, these last months our work has been quite impacted by the fact that we have been working on multiple fronts at the same time. It can lead to slower progress all in all, but is needed before any big changes can take place. We're starting to see it all "come together" and can focus on what we [b]really[/b] want again.

Our programmer [b]Cedric[/b] has updated the in-game bug report tool which is much more intuitive than before and will make it easier for us to localize and deal with bugs.

It's been a lot of fun to finally have been able to release [b]modding[/b] [i](Yay!)[/i]. This is something we have been wanting since the early days of Hospitalize, but did not really have the opportunity to before. More work still remains for some modding capabilities and we will keep a close eye on modding activity to be able to follow up loose ends.

Some have noticed that we have been working on improvements for Scopes in Departments. We did a poll in our Discord, asking what people thought was maybe not the best when it comes to Departments and it made it clear that some things can definitely be better. Working on this is priority right now.

Hope you all are as excited as we are and that you keep supporting us like always. You are tremendously helpful and awesome!

If you have any questions, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/xZmwGDZ]Discord[/url], or simply put them below!


[b]Thanks!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v0.13.4.12
notes.content:
[b]Salutations![/b]


More and more polishing! With this update the game becomes much smoother even with bigger hospitals. There are also some new added features, be sure to read about them!

With this, we're getting closer and closer to the point where we would like to introduce some new content again. We found it was vital that we took care of bugs and performance issues before we embarked on any new additions. We're very excited to be able to develop some new content again!

But first, let's read the changelog for [b]patch 0.13.4.12:[/b]

[quote][h1][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/h1]

[b]New additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a warnings & errors overview to the department mechanics:
[list]
[*] Error when a department is without any employees.
[*] Error if a department is without any rooms.
[*] Error if a department is missing scopes.
[*] Warning if a manager slot is available, but unassigned.
[*] Warning on scope troubles.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Increased the maximum room size from 200 squares to 1000 squares. [i](Yay!)[/i]

[*] Increased performance when calculating shadows.

[*] Performance increase++.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the scope to malfunction.
[*] Fixed several typos in the Tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug in the admission mechanics.
[*] Fixed an issue regarding the "Autopsy" procedure.
[*] Fixed several issues which caused patients to not be transferred to other departments.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused patients to receive tasks that are locked by Milestones.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused newly received patients to get stuck in the first department.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the 'scopes' dropdown menu to reset when pressing the "space" key.
[*] Minor improvements++.
[/list][/quote]

"Next week we're planning that [b]v0.14[/b] is going live on the Experimental Branch. This patch contains elements we're sure will be a lot of fun:
[list]
[*]Room Assignment is getting improvements which makes it a lot easier and faster, as well as adding  immidiate feedback to the player if rooms aren't working.
[*]We're also opening our Steam Workshop for modding and user made content!"[/list]
[i][b] - Illeris I Thomas[/b][/i]

[i][b] - Illeris I Hans[/b][/i]


[b]Thanks Everyone![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v0.13.4.10
notes.content:
[b]Greetings![/b]


Another patch for Hospitalize, this time featuring a lot of improvements to departments, scopes and performance! [i](And of course a bunch of bugfixing!)[/i] Like last time, we've included some input from ourselves at the end of the changelog, give them a read!

[quote][h1][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/h1]

[b]New additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added warning triangles to patients who are outside their designated department. [i](This will make it very obvious to see which patients are stuck in your hospital.)[/i]
[list]
[*] If a triangle is pointing to a patient which is out of bounds, you can click the triangle to be taken to the corresponding patient.
[*] Hovering over the triangle will show a brief description of the patient's situation.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements to the patient schedule mechanic.
[*] Employees now schedule departments for examinations and treatments during consultation.
[*]Increased performance when constructing.
[*]Increased performance when calculating shadows.
[*]Increased performance while the 'hospital settings' window is open.
[*]Performance++.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the milestone system from progressing.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Pharmacy room.
[*] Fixed an issue with the departments interface.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused patients to arrive in the wrong department.
[*] Fixed several typos.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the contract interface to stick around on the screen after completion.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused employees to participate as patients during examinations and treatments.
[*] Fixes to tasks when patients are hospitalized.
[*] Fixed several issues which caused patients to not be transferred to other departments.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused patients to receive tasks that are locked by Milestones.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused newly received patients to get stuck in the first department.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused the 'scopes' dropdown menu to reset when pressing the "space" key.
[/list][/quote]

"We have located the source of many memory leaks which will be taken care of as soon as possible. We have improved the performance a lot lately, and will continue doing so going forward. This will make the game run more smoothly on most computers as well as preventing bugs related to memory.
[i][b] - Illeris I Thomas[/b][/i]

"We recently ran a poll in our Discord server and the results showed us that the majority of you would like to see more content as well as enhanced intuitiveness. We have a lot in store for this, but right now bugfixing and performance has the most priority. Thank you to all who voted! :D"
[i][b] - Illeris I Hans[/b][/i]


[b]Thanks!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Moving forward!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Departments & what's to come.[/b][/h1]


Greetings, Everyone!

Due to many factors, it’s been a while since last update. Holidays were tight, other projects emerged and we have had to prioritize our schedules accordingly.

We’re now going full throttle [strike][i](Actually about half throttle, but you get the idea)[/i][/strike] ahead and have some information to share:

[list]
[*]Departments are getting along very nicely, thanks to everyone participating on the Experimental Branch. There was a lot about this update to wrap our heads around and it proved to have some hardships, more than we first foresaw. It has taken some time, but we have had an immense amount of feedback and are almost ready to release the full version onto the world. For those that did participate, there will be an additional post, on the Experimental Branch discussion section, about upcoming changes [i](You can find that [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/503370/discussions/4/1693785669846797109/]here[/url])[/i]. Thank you for all your help!
[*]More updates! We will try to update Hospitalize more often going forward, as we realized with Departments that it became a little overwhelming. Pour too much into the cup and it will just spill everywhere. No good! Smaller and more frequent updates will allow us to polish already existing content, making the game smoother for everyone. Great!
[*]With this, we wish to start doing the “Weekly Dev Updates” again as well. We were consistent with them for a while, but we eventually fell off the tracks along the way due to uneventful weeks. Eventually renaming them to “Dev Updates” gave us a little more breathing room, and allow us to write more detailed reports. We will at least try and do them every two weeks.
[/list]


Expect an update for [b]Hospitalize[/b] in not too long! Now, unfortunately, this update will break saves. This is because of big changes to the save & load framework, as well as how much Departments changes the game. We’re very sorry for this inconvenience!

And with that we would like to thank you for your patience during this quiet time, and wish to ask you to continue your support going forward! You guys are [i][b]awesome![/b][/i]


[b]Thanks![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v.0.12.1
notes.content:
[b][u]Info: [/u][/b]One of the biggest changes and improvements from this patch is that we have replaced our old pathfinding with a new one. A very important step for the experience and future of the game.

We've also added a completely new system we call 'Milestones'! After much testing and awesome help from everyone participating on the 'Experimental Branch', we're now ready to release it onto the stable branch.

As always, much thanks to everyone for sending in bug reports and using this forum. It helps a lot!

[h1][b]CHANGELOG:[/b][/h1]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error which caused the game to crash while loading.
[*] Fixed an error in the object popup window.
[*] Fixed an issue in the tutorial mechanics which crashed the game.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused the 'X-ray' machine to get stuck with the X-ray image. [i](The skeleton which appears on scanning would stay even after completing the X-ray)[/i]
[*] Fixed several bugs in the 'Staff' menu window.
[*] Fixed multiple typos.
[*] Fixed a bug in the 'Staff' menu window. [i](This bug drastically decreased performance while having it open.)[/i]
[*] Fixed a bug when trying to build multiple objects on the same spot.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused character roles to be swapped. [i](This would sometimes cause doctors to have consultations with other doctors.)[/i]
[*] Fixed an error when constructing 'Ambulance'.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused game settings to not load on startup.
[*] Multiple minor fixes++
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple corrections to the Tutorial.
[*] Changed 'Physiotherapy' to use an 'Examination Room' rather than an 'Office'.
[*] Performance improvements to the 'Patient Journal'.
[*] GUI improvements to the 'Mail Window'.
[*] The 'Area Deconstruction' tool has been redesigned and will now remove ALL objects. [i](It would often leave behind a couple of studs here and there.)[/i]
[*] Decreased the amount of mails regarding "Crowded room".
[*] The currency list now catches keypresses for quickly looking up currencies.
[*] Improved the 'Report a Bug' tool.
[/list]

[b]New additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] New feature: [b]Milestones[/b]
[list]
[*] Milestones will help players get a better sense of progression as well as making it a bit more exciting to play.
[*] You will now have to unlock different machines and furniture, as well as available rooms. Even diseases will have to be unlocked. The patients you receive will now only come in with the available diseases.
[*] Remember to check in on what you need to do to complete these Milestones as well as what the rewards are.
[/list]
[*] [b]Sounds![/b]
[list]
[*] We have now added sounds into Hospitalize and we think they're a great addition to the game.
[*] It livens up the place a lot more and definitely makes it more interesting to play.
[/list]
[*] Brand new [b]pathfinding[/b] engine. [i](We're sure a lot of you are happy about this, we definitely are!)[/i]
[*] Moving characters now has path visualization.
[*] Added the option to select characters in the 'Mortuary Freezer' by the object popup window. [i](Clicking on a freezer will now show who inhabits that freezer.)[/i]
[*] Added a delete button to mails in the 'Mailbox Window'. [i](You no longer have to open the mail to delete them.)[/i]
[*] Added a message to the 'Staff Window' when no personell is available.
[/list]

We're [i][b]super[/b][/i] excited to have you all try out this new update, it does a lot to the game for sure!

As always, every feedback, report and criticism is much welcomed as it helps a ton in fixing and improving the game!


[b]Thanks!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.content:
[h1][b]Vacations over, more Hospitalize![/b][/h1]

Summer is nearing its end, holidays are over and it's time to focus on going forward!

The content of the [i]experimental branch[/i] is getting ready. We will initially work to get this in place. Bugs will be removed and the content balanced and polished. Milestones work well and we have received good feedback, but more variation and customization is needed before the complete feature is done. Pathfinding has been completely replaced and has become much better. We have received a lot of feedback with bugged savegames. Efforts to correct these errors have begun.

Furthermore, we will begin the work with [b]departments.[/b] This will give players completely new challenges, and it will be even more important to think about how to build their hospital. An effective flow of patients through the hospital will give positive results, while ineffectiveness will be devastating to the hospital. Which is why we're also including schedules and day/night cycles into this update, making the game a lot more "real". Departments will of course be the entrance to multiple content upgrades with different themes. We are starting with the administration department, for which artwork is already in production! 

This summer, plans for [u]endgame[/u] started to take shape and we will work on it later this year. We can't tell too much, as it is still very fresh; But the idea is that the player will be able to bring the result or product from his hospital to a new level in the game and strengthen his position here by building new, better and [b]more hospitals![/b]


[b]Thanks![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [09.07.2017] - Week 15
notes.content:
[h1][b]New weekly update![/b][/h1]


Thank you everyone for every nice and new feedback! It means a lot to us and really helps taking the development in the right direction.

We've noticed that many of you would like a more stable version of the game and some wants more experimental versions featuring new things. We have launched an experimental version before and will do so again as we think it's very crucial that everyone who wants to can hop in and test new features immidiately if they wish, as well as having the option to jump into a properly stable version. Last time we launched the experimental version we had tons of amazing feedback and helped tremendously towards releasing to the stable version.

We have much more content planned for the game, but it is also important to have a natural progression. In order for not all content to become "overwhelming" in the beginning, we will introduce a system that unlocks parts of the game along the way. Initially, one will relate to few diagnoses, rooms and other game features, but will unlock more through completing certain goals or what we like to call "Milestones".

As always, bug reports sent in through the in-game 'Bug report' tool are extremely helpful and really is one of our strongest weapons against bugs. All bug reporting and suggestions are very much appreciated. Fixing bugs and optimalizing is still number one priority and will continue to be the main focus.

We'll see you next week!


[b]Thank you!![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [28.05.2017] - Week 10
notes.content:
[h1][b]Just a little longer, we promise![/b][/h1]


Earlier, we presented how we wanted the Doctor's handbook to look and work.
As well as getting a more tidy and prettier look with support for illustrations, it also gets a search function. This will be an important tool for those who want to micromanage patients' records.

A search for a symptom like 'Cough', will show all pages in the handbook that mention this symptom. This way you will quickly get an overview of potential diagnoses, treatments, etc.

It will work much like an in-game wiki, as stated earlier. It's now ready to be shown the world and can be tested in a brand new 'Experimental branch'. [i](More on that below)[/i]

As many probably have noticed, up until now patients haven't really been at risk at any point in the game. We're now changing this and patients can now get so ill that they [u]die[/u]. If their health is at risk, doctors will run their way and attempt to save their lives.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26360995/50e24c4810641b30a74e41cd5bfe94976271b294.png[/img]
[i](Much like this guy with his defibrillators..)[/i]

With so many big changes that this patch brings, there's also the potential for bugs. If anyone is particularly interested, we are now publishing an 'Experimental branch' on [b]Steam[/b]. There is a lot of new content available, but this is early early access and we strongly recommend that you backup your saves first, if you wish to try it out. There will be an update for this branch tomorrow as well, featuring more polish before public release.

To opt into 'Experimental branch': Find [b]Hospitalize[/b] in your game library -> Right click -> Properies -> Betas -> Opt into Experimental branch. You might also have to restart Steam for it to update.

And with that, we're very sorry the dev update got delayed! Things got a bit hectic, but now we're back on track :] See you next week!

[b][u]AND AS ALWAYS[/u][/b]: Keep sending us those bug reports, it helps out a ton!



[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [14.05.2017] - Week eight
notes.content:
[h1][b]Closing in, slowly but surely.[/b][/h1]

While we're continuing the work on the newest big patch, we'd like to share some information we have regarding the [b]'Doctors handbook'[/b] and its uses:

Right now, the game doesn't have a very good way of explaining the player how to actually play it. The 'Doctors handbook' has always been there, but it doesn't really contain very much concrete gameplay information, we'd like to change this.

We want the 'Doctors handbook' to really be something of an [i]in-game wiki[/i], that will guide you through the entire game. In order to do this, it needs an overhaul and will be [u]significantly[/u] changed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26360995/f407aba61943d5d5714e40422d27f16a83dbaca1.png[/img]

Above is a sketch of what is currently being tested, and shows how we ultimately want it to look like. It'll look more tidier and contain much more information, hopefully making it a reference table for all things Hospitalize.

All of the other windows the game offers will then have a [ ? ] in the top right, beside the [ X ] which will open up the corresponding page in the 'Doctors handbook'. Real nifty!

The [i]enhanced tutorial[/i] will incorporate this a lot.

Over to something else, we'll be creating a new branch of the game in steam, which will be an "experimental branch". This branch will get all updates much sooner than on the public branch, but [u]will contain bugs[/u]. 

This is for those who'd really like to get their hands on new content as soon as possible, but know the risk and would like to help with bugfixing. More on this later.

Super excited for the coming weeks, things will definitely go down! We'll see you then! :]


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [7.05.2017] - Week seven
notes.content:
[h1][b]Improvements and improvements[/b][/h1]

This week, the team worked on multiple aspects of the game to make sure they're up to date with the [u]big patch[/u] that will be coming out soon!

We'd like to share [i]some[/i] of those things today:
[list]
[*] Improved the responsiveness in general. This makes it better to manually control what's gonna happen to the patient in the 'Patient Journal'.
[*] Improvements to the disease mechanics, making sure critically ill patients actually are in a critical situation. [i](This makes sense when the new patch arrives)[/i]
[*] 'Emergency Events' are going to be a new core feature, which will consist of different 911 calls where you'll have to prioritise and send ambulance where it's needed the most.
[/list]
Hope you're excited, we sure are!

We had some issues with the 'Report bug' function, but as stated in the latest hotfix, it should now be [u]fixed[/u] and is up and running. Feedback and suggestions are, as always, very welcome!

That's it for this week!


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [30.04.2017] - Week six
notes.content:
[h1][b]Slow week, but we have some info![/b][/h1]

[b]Hello people of the steam forums![/b] This week we've continued work on the next big patch for Hospitalize. We're currently making sure that we have a good amount of testers ready to test this new patch before [i]release[/i], to make sure it's as polished as can get!

There aren't that many other topics to cover this week, but we felt like it was time to give away a little [u]info[/u] about the patch:

[b]Upcoming features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ambulance![/b] Some patients will now have to get picked up by the ambulance.
[*] [b]Emergency room.[/b] For this to happen there must be an 'Emergency room', to which the doctors will rush and hold an acute consultation.
[*] [b]Paramedics.[/b] These are the characters that must be aquired before being able to send out the ambulance.
[/list]

Together with this update also comes the addition of patients actually [i]dying[/i]. This makes everything a little more impactful. There will also be morgues and hearses together with this feature! We hope you're excited!!

That's about it for this week.. not too much information, but hopefully you look forward to this patch. Of course, that is just [u]some[/u] of the things to come! :] We'll see you next week!

[u][b]LAST NOTE:[/b][/u] We need all the help we can get to test and furbish the game, so please continue to give us all the feedback you can.. We appreciate it all!


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE Hotfix v.0.10.5.5
notes.content:
A quick little patch to fix some small issues we've found, as well as tweaking 'Skills' a bit.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug which caused all characters to stop working.
[*]Fixed a bug in 'Contracts' which crashed the game.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Different procedures now require the [u]relevant skills[/u] in order to be executed. This change will ultimately increase the success rate of procedures, thus increasing the patients opinion :]


[b]Thank you![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [23.04.2017] - Week five
notes.content:
[h1][b]Well on our way to the next chapter![/b][/h1]

[b]Hello everyone![/b] Starting off, this week's Hospitalize patch covered a few bugs and fixes. We've yet to locate the pharmacy and save/load bugs, but seeing as there aren't too many reports on it lately, hopefully it isn't too devastating.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [16.04.2017] - Week four
notes.content:
[h1][b]Number four already![/b][/h1]

Easter is over, and we hope you enjoyed the festive treat we threw in with the latest patch! :]

Moving forward, we have now up the speed of production and have [u]lots[/u] of exciting things in store, which is awesome!

Unfortunately, there have occurred some bugs which have been hard to locate and bring about a fix to. The game is still in [i]Alpha[/i], but we're trying to keep it as bugfree as possible.

That being said, this week, it seems more of you encountered a bug with the pharmacy, where patients would stack up and not get anywhere because of the nurses. This problem proved very tricky to recreate and hard to locate the fault. A new patch is coming up real soon, hopefully bringing a fix to this. It would greatly help if in the case you encounter it, you use the in-game 'Report Bug' function. This will send in your current savegame and we'll have the chance to look at it. [b]Thanks![/b]

People have also reported that the save/load function hasn't been working, for those of you who have this problem, if you could send in some sort of autosave to us through email, that would help a lot! Or if you're able to save, but not load, you can find your savegames in [b][u]C:\Users\”USER”\AppData\LocalLow\Illeris AS\Hospitalize​.[/u][/b] Send it to [b]support@Illeris.com[/b] and we'll be able to check it out!

We're seeing lots of reports and suggestions on the forum, and that's great to see, keep it up! :]

Other than that, there's isn't much to say this week. Stay tuned for an upcoming patch and we'll see you then!


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v.0.10.5.3
notes.content:
Easter is here, and so is a new patch for Hospitalize! It's certainly festive in the hospital these days [i](wink, wink)[/i]

Many of this patch's updates are based on your feedback!

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug which caused 'Urinalysis' to stop the game.
[*]Fixed a bug in the 'Required objects' list in the room menu.
[*]Fixed the blurry text in the room menu.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated the waypoints for the 'Operating Bed'.
[*]Adjusted pathfinding.
[*]Minor improvements++
[/list]

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]New feature: [b]Character Skills[/b]
[list]
[*][i]Characters now have the chance to level their skills through their actions. The higher the level, the tougher it becomes for them to increase the skill.[/i]
[/list]
[*]New feature: [b]Hospital Policy[/b]
[list]
[*][i]This allows the Player to globally choose what speeds certain procedures should run at. If the staff are low level in their skills, you can then choose to run a procedure at a safer speed. (This option can be found in the 'Hospital Options' tab, in a new field that's added)[/i]
[/list]
[*]Added floating text to character skill increase. [i](This shows up above their head as they level up)[/i]
[*]Added a notification to character skill increase.
[*]Added skill values to the Employee popup [i](You can now check the skills of a Staff member by clicking on them)[/i]
[/list]


[b]Thank you![/b]
[i] - Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [09.04.2017] - Week three
notes.content:
[h1][b]A tad bit late, but dev update #3 is here![/b][/h1]

Earlier this week, a big update hit the scene for Hospitalize, and it was great to finally, once again, get some new stuff out there! There have been bug reports and the crew has been working to [u]fix[/u] exactly these issues.

But, it wouldn't be possible without the great help from you guys! Reporting everything you come across really helps us fine tune and fix anything that needs fixing. [b]High five![/b]

Easter is on the way and we're busy implementing some new stuff into the game that we hope you will enjoy.

Some of the issues we've seen arise on the forums, that we think everyone should have answered:

[list]
[*] [quote=Moe ilia]Do employees gain skills while working?? or only through contracts? [/quote]
[i] - Currently, employees only gain skills through contracts, but we're currently looking at a way to enhance this :][/i]

[*] [quote=Lubmos;135513901707095731]
CT, MRI and X-Ray decreased my reputation meanwhile to 3. Other treatments as well are suddenly "bad or even worse". Actually, it does not make sense anymore, I have just 1 patient left. What a shame, after 12 hrs. game over. [/quote]
[quote=DonHaerlem;135513901703154036]I have the same problem.
The MRI-scan acts the same way btw.

It sends mails that a scan has failed and your reputation drops as a result. But both scans always seem to fail!

To boost my reputation again I dismantled both rooms, but I guess that's not the intended gameplay ;-) [/quote]
[i] - This issue is being looked at, and solution is to probably scale down the rep loss and the failrate until we've implemented the leveling of skills outside of contracts. We're also looking at a way to globally change all procedure speeds, so you can choose according to the skills of your staff.[/i]

[*] [quote=Patrick V;135513549100344515]Their is a lot of bugs that needs to be fixed. I am adding this as I go

* Loading a save game gliteches the floor tiles where door are placed on vertical plain which shows grass instead of floor tiles.
*Very hard to naviagte top menu bar without it scrolling
*Cannot Discarge Patients.
*Cannot Save Game when in-game bug report is used. [/quote]
[i] - Good amount of reports here! Many of these have been improved. The top menu navigation is currently being looked at, hopefully seeing fix in the next patch to come.[/i]
[/list]

Work has also begun on the [b]next big patch[/b], which will contain a lot of updates to [u]scheduling[/u]. What we're hoping to create is a more realistic experience when playing the game, as well as more management overall. You are the manager, right? You'll be able to see all the scheduled procedures; What doctor will do which task, choose general practitioner for patients, etc. These will be presented in a new calendar view. We hope you look forward to that!

With that, there should be a little update coming up real soon! Keep reporting whatever you can find, and remember, if you have a good idea for the game, please post a suggestion, no idea is too stupid! :]


[b]Thank you![/b]
 [i]- Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update [26.03.2017] - Week one
notes.content:
[h1][b]Good evening/afternoon/morning, Hospitalize Steam Forum![/b][/h1]

As stated in an earlier post last week here on the forum, we'll be doing [i]Weekly Dev Updates[/i] every week starting this week.

[b]Why?[/b] Much because we don't feel like you're being communicated with enough. Sure, we try to answer and help on the different threads, but it's hard for everyone to catch that, as only the person who creates the thread will have notifications of activity. 

So we think this is a good solution. With these updates we'll be going over [u]a few things:[/u]

[list]
[*] Insert some of the questions and answers in threads that were created that week that we feel the rest of the community should also know about.
[*] Give a little summary of what went down behind the scenes of future updates that was done that week. [i](This is probably the one you're most interested in, wink wink)[/i]
[*] Any info we see necessary that you get about what might've been going on that week.
[/list]

Right now, this is what we have in mind, but I'm sure that after doing it for a bit, we find more uses for these or maybe we have to change things around, we'll have to wait and see.

As you might know, a big update is coming up. There are a lot of new features and much change to the game from what it is at its current state. This is very exciting for us, actually a bit too exciting, so we're going to share some of the key features of [b]v.0.10.5.0:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Contracts[/b]. Contracts will help the player earn money and allow them to level up a certain staff member in a particular skill. [i]I.e. Surgery, Nursing.[/i]
[*] [b]New save & load system and GUI[/b]
[*] [b]Room environment & ambient variables[/b]. Patients will now get an impression of the looks of your hospital, making decorations more relevant. Patients will now also prefer less crowded rooms and will leave a bad impression if there aren't enough seats.
[*] [b]Cleaners[/b]. Cleaners replace Caretakers, turning Caretakers into explicit construction workers which will only arrive when something needs building.
[*] Along with this there are [b]new rooms, new objects, improved interface, improved options menu[/b] and much more!
[/list]

We really hope you're looking forward to it! It's been a while since we had an update going and are eager for you to get your hands on it.



[b]Thank you![/b]
 [i]- Illeris Team

notes.title: HOSPITALIZE v.0.10.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Features of v0.10.4.1:[/b]

•	Better performance, better enjoyment! A lot of this update’s focus has been to improve performance of the game and the behaviour of the characters. The game should now run more smoothly, even if your hospital is enormous!

•	Together with the better performance, many bugs and glitches have     been sorted out; Placement of items, pathfinding of characters, machines not working properly, and more! Take a look down below for the full details and jump in-game to check it out for yourself!

[b]New Additions:[/b]

•	New medical equipment: ‘Ultrasound’.
•       New sanitation object: 'Trash can'.
•	New room: ‘Sonography’.
•	New treatment: ‘Surgery (Cholecystectomy)’.
•	New illness: ‘Gallstone’.
•	New illness: ‘Pancreatitis’.
•	New symptom: ‘Shoulder pain’.
•	New symptom: ‘Abdomen pain’.
•	Added a ‘Clean room’ task for Caretakers.

[b]Changes:[/b]

•	Replaced the bus sprite.
•	Reduced the range needed for characters to trigger a door to open.
•	Adjusted prices on ‘Toilet’ and ‘Sink’.
•	Adjusted the task priority of consultation and discharge actions.
•	Adjusted ‘Pharmacy’ room size.
•	Actions initiated by the player through the ‘Journal’ now always gets highest priority.
•	Patient’s ‘waiting script’ has been improved.
•	Upgraded the engine and developer tools to Unity 5.4.1.

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

•	Fixed the placing of ‘Office chair’.
•	Fixed the sorting of lists.
•       Fixed an error when zooming in/out during ‘Room assignment’ mode.
•	Fixed a bug which caused characters to walk strangely after loading the game.
•	Fixed the pathfinding for placing the ‘X-ray’.
•	Fixed the ‘X-ray’ sprite.
•	Fixed the ‘CT-scanner’ sprite.
•	Fixed a bug which caused characters to run off to the bottom left corner of the map.
•	Fixed a bug where dirt and filth would hide beneath the floor tiles.
•	Fixed the autosave timer.
•	Fixed a bug which caused the construction of ‘WC’ to stop the game from progressing.
•	Fixed typos in the tutorials.
•	Fixed blurred in-game fonts.
•	Fixed a bug which caused all patients to choose the same pharmacy.
•	Fixed a bug which caused patients to perform same activity multiple times in a row.
•	Fixed a bug which caused the count of patients to be wrong.
•	Fixed a bug which caused the speed buttons to be unresponsive.
•	Fixed a bug which caused the camera not being able to see the borders of the map.
•       Fixed a bug which caused the delivery truck to stop. 
•	Overlapping walls no longer charge double the amount.
•	Hospital capacity settings now saves and loads correctly.
•	Improved the time stamp of saved games.
•	Improved the sample rate of SFX for the volume slider.

[u]IMPORTANT:[/u] This update will break your already existing saves, we apologize for that. As a final note, should you find anything out of place, please report it here on the Steam forums, or by emailing us at [b]support@illeris.com[/b]!


Have fun!
 - [i]Illeris Team[/i]

notes.title: Hospitalize 0.102
notes.content:
Hi, 

First of all, a big “Thank you” to everyone who is supporting this game. It has been some amazing first few days, and it is all thanks to you. 

For feedback, please use steam forums or send us an e-mail. It has been hectic since launch, so feedback will probably take some time.
 
Now to the interesting part...
The biggest challenge now is the issues with characters movement. It has multiple causes and needs to be fixed one at a time. This patch includes an updated construction preview, to help the player place objects and avoid that pathfinding waypoints are placed inside walls. This should drastically reduce the number of times the pathfinding mechanics goes into “escape mode”.

Some objects are now possible to store away and to reconstruct later. By pressing “Store” in the object selection view, caretakers will be ordered to deconstruct the object. Stored objects will then be available in the construction menu and can be rebuilt at a new location.

Hospitalize 0.102 
Changelog 
- New feature: Store objects
- Missions: New static mission (Pharmacy)
- Missions: Static missions 2-4 are now initiated by the completion of the previous mission.
- GUI: Construction preview places silhouettes at object waypoints
- Balance: Reception area max size increased to 192
- Balance: Waiting room max size increased to 192
- Balance: Random mission money rewards increased
- Gameplay: Construction workers now carries their crates
- Minor fixes+++


The previous build is available in beta section.

Regards
-Thomas
